behaviorChanges: SessionStart standing-directive hook registered (plugin manifest + settings writer + install-hooks + self-enforcing lane-start migration) for directive-core's `autonomy-directive --hook`; the hook ALWAYS emits (no dedup), so compaction/resume re-inject the directive by construction (at-most-double emission on dual-registered machines is accepted, cosmetic). The hook-state gate extends to a NINTH required hook: methodology-status --fail-on-drift now blocks startup when the SessionStart entry is missing on a settings-managed install -- a previously-passing install can now block, recoverable with `tautline install-hooks`. No guard/gate/review semantics change beyond the existing hook-state gate covering one more artifact.

requiredMigrations.command: gh auth refresh --hostname github.com -s read:project -s project
requiredMigrations.description: Carried forward from 0.10.3 for lanes updating across it: grant the gh token the GitHub Projects scopes the fail-closed board gates need. Machines already on 0.10.3+ or whose token carries read:project and project need no action.

rollbackNotes: Rolling back THIS release alone leaves the persisted ~/.claude/settings.json SessionStart entry active, and directive-core (the immediate predecessor) already ships `autonomy-directive --hook`, so injection CONTINUES after rollback until the operator either deletes the SessionStart entry carrying this release's exact command string `/bin/sh -c 'command -v tautline >/dev/null 2>&1 && tautline autonomy-directive --hook 2>/dev/null || true'` (foreign SessionStart entries preserved) OR sets `autonomy.standingDirective: false` in the lane adapter. The missing-executable fail-open only covers rollback to pre-directive-core versions; on those the shell guard exits 0 silently and the directive stops. Nothing on disk migrates.
